summary: Practise needs assessment, response planning and accountability using humanitarian standards. Explore the five-day foundation course.
lede: Humanitarian training helps people beginning response work assess crisis needs, plan assistance and monitor whether it reaches communities safely and accountably. Practical exercises build skills in analysing evidence gaps, collecting field information with KoboToolbox, identifying protection and access concerns, and developing response plans, community feedback records and monitoring summaries guided by the Humanitarian Programme Cycle, the Sphere Handbook and the Core Humanitarian Standard.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for people beginning humanitarian response work who contribute to assessment, field delivery, coordination, protection, community accountability or monitoring. It suits you if you need to turn changing crisis information into practical actions and document how assistance responds to community priorities.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: prior knowledge requirements are not specified. Coding or programming is not required for the described foundation-level exercises. KoboToolbox use focuses on field-information structure and review; advanced technical configuration is outside the stated scope.
